name: Environmental Committee - Notice of Meeting Date Change from April 15, 2026 to April 20, 2026
agenda_text:
Meeting of the City Council's
  ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE

  NOTICE OF CANCELLATION
  MEETING DATE ADJUSTMENT

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN the following REGULAR meeting has been
cancelled:

  APRIL 15, 2026 AT 4:00 p.m.
  AS CITY COUNCIL WILL BE HOLDING A STUDY SESSION AND
  SPECIAL MEETING ON APRIL 15, 2026

  THE ENVIRONMENTAL MEETING DATE HAS BEEN
  CHANGED TO
  APRIL 20, 2026 AT 4:00 p.m.

April 9, 2026

I, Antoinette M. Mann, declare as follows:

  That I am the City of Westlake Village City Clerk. The Regular Meeting for the
Administrative Committee (City Council Committee) scheduled for April 15, 2026 has
been moved to April 20, 2026 at 4:00 pm.
  I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct.

___________________________________
Antoinette M. Mann
City Clerk

Posted:  City Hall Public Notice Board, City Website
